verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at configurability via the Agent SDK, which gives developers 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions' (claude-code-docs-18), and mentions integrations like Jira, Slack, Google Drive, and custom tooling (claude-code-docs-4), but there's no explicit documentation of an engineering-lead-facing allow/deny list or admin console for restricting tool access in the core CLI product. Community reports raise trust concerns (hidden 'fake_tools' injection, undercover mode, security lapses) that further undercut confidence in transparent, lead-controlled tool governance.
